# Avsnitt 600 - Snabbvisit i börshimlen

**Feed**: fill-or-kill  
**Published**: 2026-09-29  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

In episode 600 of Fill or Kill, the hosts spend most of the time on biotech. Nanexa signed a headline-grabbing GLP-1 licensing deal with Novo Nordisk. uniQure's four-year Huntington's data crashed the stock about 70–80%, then it rebounded sharply once the hosts argued the FDA-agreed endpoint (TFC) was still intact. They also cover Brazil's sudden ban on online betting and its effect on Kambi, Better Collective and Evolution, Hemnet losing ground to Booli, and macro topics: oil, rising rates, the US midterms and a possible pre-election rally. The mood is mixed: large single-stock gains and crashes, weak Swedish risk sentiment, and a sideways index that hides weakness in small caps.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟡 NANEXA — Nanexa | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Host is a long-time owner after the Novo GLP-1 deal plus the Moderna partnership. Large cash inflow for own projects. Faster regulatory path.

#### Reasoning

The Novo deal (up to €1.1bn headline) and the Moderna mRNA partnership validate the technology. A shorter 505(b)(2)-style path (phase 1 then phase 3, 4-5 years) and royalties add upside. Market cap is ~US$200m after the pullback from 15 to 10 SEK. Weak Swedish risk sentiment weighs on it, but the host sees Camurus-like potential. Upfront payment is undisclosed.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the upfront payment disclosed in the report is disappointingly small
- if Novo or Moderna trials fail or the partnership ends
- if Swedish risk sentiment keeps compressing the valuation

> *"Vissa vill säga att det här är nya Tetra Pak inom drug delivery."*

---

### 🟢 QURE — uniQure | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Host bought at 17 after reading the four-year data. The FDA-agreed TFC endpoint is intact, the control group is biased, and there is no alternative treatment.

#### Reasoning

The crash to 8 was below the host's ~$11 net cash estimate. The weak cUHDRS result stems from a small n=12 sample and an external control group that lost its sickest half. TFC, the FDA primary endpoint, held from year 3 to year 4. Accelerated approval for Huntington's is expected around Apr-May. The host also takes partial profits to manage risk. Highly volatile.

#### Sell Triggers

- if FDA rejects or delays the BLA
- if TFC data deteriorates
- if the new FDA leadership reverts to a restrictive stance

> *"fan jag tror man måste köpa här för att nu har jag gått igenom datorn och det ser inte så dåligt ut"*

---

### 🟢 KAMBI — Kambi | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

One host bought more after the ~7% drop on Brazil's betting ban, since Brazil is only low single digits of revenue. Bolsonaro's son is favoured and pro-sportsbetting.

#### Reasoning

The Brazil executive order is valid for 120 days and needs Congress approval. A consultancy gives a sportsbetting ban only a 5% chance. The hosts expect Lula to lose. Kambi's exposure is small (2-3% of revenue), so they see the sell-off as an overreaction; the market closed it positive Monday. The other host owns it but did not add.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Lula wins the election and the ban becomes law
- if the ban spreads to sportsbetting in other markets

> *"Jag köpte mer Kambi här för att den var ju ner 7% och sen gick den ner mer på måndagen."*

---

### 🟡 ABCL — AbCellera | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Host holding, strong momentum: up 10% yesterday, strong today at ~14.30.

#### Reasoning

Owned by the host and followed for a long time. Strong recent price action ('går som tåget'). No fundamental catalyst is detailed.

#### Sell Triggers

- if momentum reverses on sector-wide biotech de-risking

> *"Den går ju som tåget liksom. Den var upp 10% igår"*

---

### 🟢 SMMT — Summit Therapeutics | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 45%

Host bought at ~16.70, below the ~18.50 price at which AstraZeneca invested US$2bn.

#### Reasoning

AstraZeneca's US$2bn investment at a premium, in a hot oncology area, sets a reference value. The stock trades well below it, which the host sees as an opportunity. Speculative trade.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the AZ deal terms disappoint or oncology data fails

> *"Långt under vad Astra var beredda att stoppa in 2 miljarder dollar"*

---

### ⛔ HEM — Hemnet | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Losing to Booli. Copying Booli's scraping model, cut a third of staff, profits falling. Host calls it 'nådastöten'.

#### Reasoning

Hemnet's USP of paid listing visibility is eroding as Booli aggregates everything. Agents treat Hemnet as a last resort, off-market sales are growing, and price hikes have angered agents. It is Sweden-only, so growth is limited. A bid from EQT/Idealista is possible, but they may not need to buy. The stock is short-squeeze-prone after being heavily shorted, so the host is not actively short.

#### Sell Triggers

- if an aggregator such as EQT/Idealista bids for the company
- if the new scraping and preview model stabilises traffic and listings

> *"det känns som att liksom Booli äter dem varje dag som går"*

---

### 🟠 BETCO — Better Collective | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Fell 20-25% and withdrew guidance on the Brazil ban. A Bolsonaro win could reverse it, making it a 'Brazil bet' on the Swedish exchange.

#### Reasoning

Heavy Brazil exposure. The hosts believe Bolsonaro's son will win (Polymarket ~55/45) and that he is pro-sportsbetting, which makes the stock a binary election play.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Lula wins the election
- if Congress ratifies the ban

> *"Det blir extremt viktigt för Better Collective och även resten av spelbranschen."*

---
